goal: Prevent a memory leak on Windows whenever an external subprocess is spawned
Protects Windows nodes using external signers from accumulating leaked memory over time
reviewability: Ready for review; nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Early support with no open objections

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes an unfreed buffer leak on Windows subprocess invocation
Impact is marginal because external signer invocations are infrequent and the leaked buffer is small
